蘭和中國青海、江西等地，掌控了多處優質                  Province in China, enables us to operate several high-quality lithium
鋰礦資源，形成了穩定、優質、多元化的原                  resources, which gives us a stable, high-quality and diverse raw materials
材料供應體系。公司就大部分鋰礦資源簽訂                  supply system. The Company has entered into long-term procurement
了長期採購協議。公司現用的主要鋰資源為                  agreements with regard to a majority of such lithium resources. Lithium
澳 大 利 亞Mount Marion項 目。公 司 通 過 持 續   resources currently used by the Company are mainly sourced from
投資上遊鋰資源公司及簽署長期戰略採購協                  the Mount Marion Project in Australia. The Company has ensured and
議，保障與鞏固了上遊優質鋰原材料的穩定                  cemented the stable supply of high quality upstream lithium raw materials
供應。                                  through continuously investing in upstream lithium resource companies and
                                     entering into long-term strategic procurement agreements.

鋰電池負極材料；(2)醫藥反應催化劑；(3)合              according to the customers’ needs, which are mainly used (1) as lithium
金及其他工業品材料，客戶包括電池製造商                  battery anode materials; (2) as pharmaceutical catalysts; and (3) in alloys

    固態電池：公司較早佈局固態電池技術，利                              Solid-state batteries: The Company has been an early mover in solid-
    用自身優勢，自研自產的氧化物電解質材料、                             state battery technology. Leveraging its in-house strengths, its self-
    硫化物粉體材料均具有更高離子電導率和工                              developed and self-produced oxide electrolyte materials and sulfide powder
    程化能力；新一代混合固液鋰離子電池在大                              materials demonstrate higher ionic conductivity and enhanced engineering
    幅提升能量密度的同時，在多點針刺測試、                              capabilities. The new generation of hybrid solid-liquid lithium-ion batteries
    加熱測試中體現出更優異的安全性能；在續                              not only significantly improves energy density but also exhibits superior
    航方面，高比能電芯滿足長里程需求，在極                              safety performance in multi-point nail penetration tests and heating tests.
    低溫寒冷條件下仍保持強勁動力。公司持續                              In terms of endurance, the high-specific-energy cells meet long-range
    推進固態鋰電池的研發、生產和商業化應用，                             requirements while maintaining strong power output even under extremely
    積極佈局和開發高能量密度、高功率的飛行                              cold conditions. The Company continues to advance the R&D, production,
    動力電芯與電源系統產品，以滿足不同領域                              and commercial application of solid-state lithium batteries, actively
    需求。                                              developing high-energy-density, high-power aviation power cells and power
                                                     system products to meet diverse industry demands.

    鋰電池回收：電動汽車及消費型電子產品的                              Lithium battery recycling: As the use of electric vehicles and consumer
    使用必將帶動退役鋰電池處理的社會需求不                              electronic products will certainly lead to an escalating social demand for
    斷增加，公司開展鋰電池回收業務市場前景                              treatment of retired lithium batteries, the Company’s lithium battery recycling
    廣闊，經濟潛力巨大，並可進一步豐富了鋰                              business will have a promising market as well as enormous economic
    原料的多元化供應渠道，實現鋰、鎳、鈷、                              potential. It can also further enrich the diversified supplies of lithium raw
    錳等金屬的資源綜合循環利用。公司回收退                              materials from various sources, thus realizing the comprehensive recycling
    役鋰電池業務為電池生產商及電動汽車生產                              of the resources of metals such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese, etc.
    商提供了可持續的增值解決方案，進一步鞏                              The Company’s engagement in recycling retired lithium batteries provides
    固與來自電池生產業務客戶的關係。                                 battery manufacturers and electric vehicles producers with sustainable

                         CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT

過去的2023年，集團各業務部門砥礪前行，苦修內功，持
續在資源保供、項目建設、產品研發、工藝優化、運營管
理等諸多領域取得顯著進展。


2024年，我們要清醒認識行業週期性調整的客觀現實，
對公司發展保持信心。當前全球能源轉型大勢未改，鋰
電產業長期向好的基本面未變，贛鋒在資源佈局、技術儲
備、人才梯隊等方面已形成顯著優勢。只要企業保持戰略
定力，走出自己的節奏，必能在產業變革浪潮中把握主動
權，為全球能源轉型貢獻更多力量。

Throughout 2023, the Group’s various business
departments have forged ahead with determination,
focused on improving internal capabilities, and made
significant progress across many areas, including
resource security, project construction, product
research and development, process optimization,
and operational management.

In 2024, we must clearly recognize the objective
reality of the industry’s cyclical adjustments
while maintaining confidence in the Company’s
development. The global energy transition trend
remains unchanged, and the long-term positive
fundamentals of the lithium battery industry have not
altered. Ganfeng has already established significant
advantages in areas such as resource allocation,
technological reserves, and talent development. As
long as the Company stays focused on its strategy
and maintains its own pace, it will be able to take the
initiative in the wave of industrial transformation and
contribute even more to the global energy transition.



                           主席              李良彬
                           Chairman        Li Liangbin

     8.    固態電池市場分析                                          8.   Analysis of the solid-state battery market

           固 態 電 池 是 一 種 新 型 儲 能 技 術，其 工                          Solid-state batteries are a new type of energy storage technology,
           作 原 理 與 液 態 鋰 離 子 電 池 相 似。固 態                          with operating principles similar to liquid lithium-ion batteries. The main
           鋰離子電池的主要材料包括正極材料、                                      materials of solid-state lithium-ion batteries include cathode materials,
           負 極 材 料 和 固 態 電 解 質 等，其 核 心 在                          anode materials and solid electrolytes. The core of this technology lies
           於將液態電池的電解液與隔膜替換成                                       in replacing the electrolyte solutions and diaphragms of liquid batteries
           固 態 電 解 質，實 現 不 用 或 者 少 用 隔 膜                          with solid electrolytes, reducing or eliminating the need for diaphragms
           及 電 解 液，相 較 於 傳 統 鋰 離 子 電 池 具                          and electrolyte solutions. Compared to traditional lithium-ion batteries,
           備 更 高 能 量 密 度（單 位 體 積╱重 量 下                            solid-state batteries offer higher energy density (storing more electric
           存儲更多電能）、更快的充電速度、更                                      energy per unit volume/weight), faster charging speeds, longer service
           長 的 使 用 壽 命 以 及 更 高 的 安 全 性（避                          life, and increased safety (mitigating risks of liquid electrolyte leakage
           免 液 態 電 解 液 洩 漏、燃 燒 風 險），但                             and combustion). However, this technology currently faces challenges
           目前這項技術仍面臨電解質材料成本                                       such as high costs of electrolyte materials, high interface impedance,
           高、界 面 阻 抗 大、規 模 化 生 產 工 藝 不                            and immature large-scale production processes. Solid-state batteries
           成 熟 等 挑 戰，被 視 為 下 一 代 電 池 技 術                          are considered a crucial direction for the development of the next
           的 重 要 發 展 方 向。近 年 來，固 態 電 池                            generation of battery technology. In recent years, significant progress
           的 研 發 和 產 業 化 取 得 了 明 顯 進 展，根                          has been made in R&D and industrialization of solid-state batteries.

           2030年，全 球 固 態 電 池 出 貨 量 將 達 到                          to reach a milestone around 2030. It is expected that by 2030, the

      且認識到董事會層面的多元化對於保持競爭                              governance and recognizes the vital importance of Board diversity for

      元化問題，包括但不限於性別、年齡、文化                              Board diversity from a number of perspectives, including but not limited

      期限長短及作為董事將需投入的時間等。                               skills, knowledge, length of services and time to be devoted as a Director.

      保其具有均衡的技能、經驗及觀點多元化，                              the Board. The Board strives to ensure that it has the balance of skills,

           業務合併及商譽                      Business combinations and goodwill

           業務合併採用收購法入賬。轉移               Business combinations are accounted for using the acquisition

           當日轉移的資產的公允價值、本               date fair values of assets transferred by the Group, liabilities

           負債及本集團為獲得被收購企業               and the equity interests issued by the Group in exchange for
           的控制權所發行的股本權益三項               control of the acquiree. For each business combination, the
           之和。各次業務合併中，本集團               Group elects whether to measure the non-controlling interests
           選擇以公允價值或被於收購方可               in the acquiree at fair value or at the proportionate share of the
           識別資產淨值的應佔比例，計量               acquiree’s identifiable net assets. All other components of non-
           於被收購方的非控股權益。非控               controlling interests are measured at fair value. Acquisition-
           股權益的所有其他部分以公允價               related costs are expensed as incurred.
           值計量。收購相關成本在產生時
           確認為開支。

           當所收購的一組活動及資產包括               The Group determines that it has acquired a business when
           一項投入及一項實質性過程，而               the acquired set of activities and assets includes an input and a
           兩者共同對創造產出的能力有重               substantive process that together significantly contribute to the
           大貢獻，則本集團認為其已收購               ability to create outputs.
           一項業務。

           當本集團收購一項業務時，會根               When the Group acquires a business, it assesses the financial

           公允價值計量                      Fair value measurement

           本集團在各報告期末，以公允價              The Group measures its derivative financial instruments and
           值計量其衍生金融工具及股權投              equity investments at fair value at the end of each reporting
           資。公允價值是指在計量日，市              period. Fair value is the price that would be received to sell
           場參與者在正常交易活動中銷售              an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
           資產收到或者清償債務所支付的              between market participants at the measurement date. The
           金額。公允價值計量基於假設銷              fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the
           售資產或清償債務的交易發生於              transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place
           該資產或負債的主要市場，或者              either in the principal market for the asset or liability, or in the
           在缺失主要市場的情況下，發生              absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous
           於在最有利於該資產或負債的市              market for the asset or liability. The principal or the most
           場。主要市場或者最優市場必須              advantageous market must be accessible by the Group.
           是本集團可以參與的市場。資產              The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the
           或負債的公允價值乃基於市場參              assumptions that market participants would use when pricing
           與者在釐定資產或負債的定價時              the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in
           所使用的假設計量，並假設市場              their economic best interest.
           參與者以其最佳經濟利益行事。

           非金融資產公允價值的計量需考              A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
           慮市場參與者在最優化使用該資              account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
           產或者將其銷售給另一個能夠最              benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by
           優化使用該資產的市場參與者的              selling it to another market participant that would use the asset
           情況下產生經濟利益的能力。               in its highest and best use.

           本集團在不同的情形下使用適當              The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in
           的估值技術，為準確計量公允價              the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to
           值需獲取充足的數據，最大化使              measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable
           用相關可觀測輸入值，最小化使              inputs and minimising the use of unobservable inputs.
           用不可觀察輸入值。

                    金融資產減值                                            Impairment of financial assets

                     本集團確認對並非按公允價值計                                   The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit losses
                     入損益的所有債務工具預期信貸                                   (“ECLs”) for all debt instruments not held at fair value through
                     虧損（「預期信貸虧損」）的撥備。                                 profit or loss. ECLs are based on the difference between the
                     預期信貸虧損乃基於根據合約到                                   contractual cash flows due in accordance with the contract and
                     期的合約現金流量與本集團預期                                   all the cash flows that the Group expects to receive, discounted
                     收取的所有現金流量之間的差額                                   at an approximation of the original effective interest rate. The
                     而釐定，並以原實際利率的近似                                   expected cash flows will include cash flows from the sale of
                     值貼現。預期現金流量將包括出                                   collateral held or other credit enhancements that are integral to
                     售所持抵押的現金流量或組成合                                   the contractual terms.
                     約條款的其他信貸提升措施。

                    一般方法                                              General approach

                    預期信貸虧損分兩個階段進行確                                    ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for

             量借款利率」）計量租賃負債。增量借                                  to measure lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest that the

             用 權 資 產 有 類 似 價 值 的 資 產。因 此，                       IBR therefore reflects what the Group “would have to pay”, which
             增量借款利率反映了本集團「應支付」                                  requires estimation when no observable rates are available (such as
             的利率，當無可觀察的利率時（如就並                                  for subsidiaries that do not enter into financing transactions) or when
             無訂立融資交易的附屬公司而言）或當                                  it needs to be adjusted to reflect the terms and conditions of the
             須對利率進行調整以反映租賃的條款                                   lease (for example, when leases are not in the subsidiary’s functional
             及 條 件 時（如 當 租 賃 並 非 以 附 屬 公 司                      currency). The Group estimates the IBR using observable inputs
             的功能貨幣訂立時），則須作出利率估                                  (such as market interest rates) when available and is required to make
             計。當 可 觀 察 輸 入 數 據 可 用 時，本 集                        certain entity-specific estimates (such as the subsidiary’s stand-alone

      39. 儲備                                               39. RESERVES

             本集團當前及過往年度的儲備金金額                                 The amounts of the Group’s reserves and the movements therein
             及變動於財務報表第207至208頁的綜                              for the current and prior years are presented in the consolidated
             合權益變動表內列示。                                       statement of changes in equity on pages 207 to 208 of the financial
                                                              statements.

             根 據 中 國 內 地 公 司 法，本 公 司 須 將 根                    In accordance with the Company Law of the Chinese Mainland, a
             據中國內地會計準則釐定的除所得稅                                 subsidiary of the Group which is a domestic enterprise is required to
             後利潤的10%轉撥至法定盈餘公積金，                               allocate 10% of its profit after tax, as determined in accordance with
             直 至 儲 備 結 餘 達 到 其 註 冊 資 本 的50%                   the relevant Chinese Mainland accounting standards, to its statutory
             為 止。根 據 中 國 內 地 公 司 法 的 若 干 限                    surplus reserve until the reserve reaches 50% of its registered
             制，部分法定盈餘公積金可轉為股本，                                capital. Subject to certain restrictions set out in the Company Law
             惟資本化後的餘額不少於註冊資本的                                 of the Chinese Mainland, part of the statutory surplus reserve may
             25%。法 定 盈 餘 公 積 金 餘 額 達 到 本 公                    be converted to share capital, provided that the remaining balance
             司 股 本 的50%。因 此，本 公 司 未 根 據                       after the capitalisation is not less than 25% of the registered capital.
            《中華人民共和國公司法》於2024年提                               The balance of the statutory surplus reserve has reached 50% of
             取法定盈餘公積金。                                        the Company’s share capital. As a result, the Company did not
                                                              appropriate statutory surplus reserve in 2024 in accordance with the
                                                              PRC Company Law.

             鑒於鋰能源行業處於快速增長階段，                                 Given the rapid growth phase of the Li-energy industry, the board
             董 事 會 建 議 並 經 股 東 批 准 於2024                      of directors proposed and shareholders approved the appropriation
             年向任意盈餘公積金計提人民幣                                   of RMB2,105,000,000 to the discretionary surplus reserve in 2024.
             2,105,000,000元。該 等 資 金 將 用 於 企                   These funds will be utilised for capital expenditure on corporate
